options.idea: Stabilizing a rain-softened rammed-earth wall fragment in an indoor conservation workshop; freshly tamped damp soil closes a crack while dry grains fall below.
Keeping an excavated soil block intact in a conservation atelier; an exposed root tunnel begins to crumble as the worker supports the edge and adds damp backing.
Repairing a flood-damaged scale architectural model made from compacted earth; a silt waterline, slumped corner and hand-packed repair explain a quiet moment of relief.
Restoring a worn earthen plaster relief in a pigment workshop; raw earth being crushed and sifted becomes a damp color patch while powder transfers onto a worker’s apron.
